items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: You played with Rainey, too. Oh, yeah. He played a long time with Rainey.

ctx.x: Did you ever work with Al Morgan? You remember him? His bass player?
Albert Morgan? Uh-huh. Yes, sir. We had him playing with us, sir. You played with Rainey, too. Oh, yeah. He played a long time with Rainey.
I wanted to ask you some more about these brass bands. What do you think is the biggest and the best parade you ever worked at?
